newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to toughen stance on oil smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to toughen stance on oil smuggling.

text.p: The new Thai government said on Monday that it would toughen its stance on oil smuggling into the country and launch crackdowns against offenders.
Deputy Prime Minister Sukavit Rangsitphol told senior government officials that more than four billion litres of oil were smuggled into the country each year.
"Not only does the smuggling mean huge losses in revenue for the government, it has also harmed the marine environment with oil leaks due to lack of proper transportation," he said.
Sukavit said the government would step up efforts to curb such illegal activities but did not reveal exact action plans.
Most of the refined oil products smuggled into the Thailand was gas oil.
